# fortiappseccloud_waf_ddos_prevention

Configures DDoS prevention for one FortiAppSec Cloud application using the static app endpoint `/waf/apps/{ep_id}/ddos_prevention`. Set `template = false` and provide `configs` to manage settings directly. Set `template = true` and omit `configs` to inherit this module from the application's attached WAF template.

Declare only one `fortiappseccloud_waf_ddos_prevention` resource for an application endpoint. Template-level settings are managed by `fortiappseccloud_waf_template_ddos_prevention`.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "fortiappseccloud_waf_ddos_prevention" "example" {
  ep_id    = fortiappseccloud_waf_app.example.ep_id
  template = false

  configs {
    status             = true
    action             = "block_period"
    challenge          = "real-browser-enforcement"
    http_access_limit  = true
    http_request_limit = 1000
    conn_flood_check   = true
    conn_flood_limit   = 100
    http_flood_prevent = true
    http_session_limit = 500
    tcp_flood_prevent  = false
    tcp_conn_num_limit = 255
    block_period       = 600

    ip_exception {
      item {
        ip = "1.1.1.1-1.1.1.2,1.1.1.4"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

- `ep_id` (Required, Forces replacement) — Application endpoint ID. Import uses this exact value and it must contain a non-whitespace character.
- `template` (Required) — Whether effective configuration is inherited from the attached template.
- `configs` (Block) — Required when `template = false` and forbidden when `template = true`. State keeps this block null when template inheritance is enabled.
  - `action` (Optional, Computed) — Sets Action. One of `alert`, `alert_deny`, `block_period`, `deny_no_log`. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `block_period` (Optional, Computed) — Sets Block period. Between 1 and 3600. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `challenge` (Optional, Computed) — Sets Challenge. One of `captcha-enforcement`, `disabled`, `real-browser-enforcement`. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `conn_flood_check` (Optional, Computed) — Controls Conn flood check for DDoS prevention. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `conn_flood_limit` (Optional, Computed) — Sets Conn flood limit. Between 1 and 1024. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `http_access_limit` (Optional, Computed) — Controls Http access limit for DDoS prevention. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `http_flood_prevent` (Optional, Computed) — Controls Http flood prevent for DDoS prevention. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `http_request_limit` (Optional, Computed) — Sets Http request limit. Between 1 and 65535. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `http_session_limit` (Optional, Computed) — Sets Http session limit. Between 0 and 4096. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `status` (Optional, Computed) — Enables or disables DDoS prevention. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `tcp_conn_num_limit` (Optional, Computed) — Sets Tcp conn num limit. Between 10 and 65535. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `tcp_flood_prevent` (Optional, Computed) — Controls Tcp flood prevent for DDoS prevention. Omission preserves the current value.
  - Scalar collection ownership — Each block below contains ordered `item` blocks carrying a single string value. Omitting a collection block preserves the complete raw remote array and keeps the block null in state. A present empty block sends `[]`. A present block with items replaces the complete array in Terraform order.
    - `ip_exception` (Optional Block) — Owns the ordered `ip_exception.item` blocks.
      - `ip_exception.item.ip` (Required) — One string value per `item` block.


## Import

Import using the application `ep_id`:

```shell
terraform import fortiappseccloud_waf_ddos_prevention.example application-endpoint-id
```

The first read after import hydrates all ownership wrappers when `template = false`.

## Destroy Behavior
Destroy performs a fresh GET, preserves the complete response, sets `template=false` and `configs.status=false`, sends the complete PUT, and verifies the normalized GET response before Terraform removes the resource from state.
